rule: This file is the canonical id list. Unknown ids fail closed. A catalog row is not proof a runtime, adapter, or scheduler exists.

hermes.name: Hermes Agent
hermes.role: Kanban + gateway/peer A2A. AODL compiles to a Hermes profile; it does not replace Kanban. Upstream IR issue: NousResearch/hermes-agent#88589.

omp.name: Oh My Pi
omp.role: Pi fork. Dash adapter: omp -p --mode json. Firstmate verified primary with a blocking session_stop hook.

o8.name: o8
o8.role: Desktop control room over other CLIs. Not an AODL executor by itself.

codex.name: Codex
codex.role: OpenAI terminal coding agent. Dash: codex exec --json.

pi.name: Pi
pi.role: Earendil terminal harness. Dash adapter: pi --mode json --approve. Firstmate co-primary.

fx.name: fx
fx.role: Vercel Labs unix-like coding agent. Dash adapter: fx ask --json --full-access. Not antonmedv/fx.

firstmate.name: firstmate
firstmate.role: Agent distro, not a harness. Captain talks to one liaison; crewmates ship from disposable worktrees. Keel L9 names it as an optional subordinate executor.

aodl.owns: IR, schema, fail-closed validator, visual encodings, this catalog

dash.owns: phone UI + Tailscale bridge that spawns executor CLIs

frontier-kb.owns: cross-harness research notes; points at this catalog

hermes-keel.owns: Hermes-only governance. Level 0 only. Not a scheduler. Not Firstmate.

blueprint.owns: product goal. First slice: autonomous product management expressed as C(RAID).

evolve.owns: legacy C(RAID)/Claude Flow orchestration. Distilled into AODL; not a second IR.
